sources.mathematical_role_and_hypotheses: Compact sphere and i2-module conventions; Corollary 7.1 nonzero commutative special fiber and degree-zero F₂; Theorem 10.1(8) negative-weight vanishing after a-inversion. Theorem 2.1, Theorem 10.1(5), Theorem 4.3, Proposition 7.6, Lemma 9.4 and Proposition 9.1 support the quotient correction and known models.

source_review_limits: The original problem page uses canonical HTTP; no security warning was bypassed.

An initial guessed publisher route returned a different article and was rejected by title/author checks. The BHS PDF was then located through the verified DOI-resolved publisher page and its actual PDF metadata. The rejected article is not used as a mathematical source.

Some web-tool page opens failed; recorded HTTPS retrievals succeeded without TLS changes. The independent audit used retained AIM and Borel passages where live requests failed. Failed requests are not represented as successful retrievals.
The comparison covers the cited conventions and statements, not whole-document mathematical equivalence or byte identity.
The arXiv PDF public URLs are unversioned download URLs; the retained bytes are separately pinned, with their recorded version labels. No claim is made about bytes returned by a later retrieval.
bounded_search_scope: Recorded searches covered the full BHS title and journal reference, a-local with Artin–Tate terms, and compact-generator/monogenic variants. No later intrinsic-recognition theorem or identical compact-generation statement was found in those bounded results. This is not an exhaustive literature search and does not prove global openness or novelty.
